descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Head Controlling Exchanges (80-100%) Madrid, Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8051 Do you want to help shape the financial steering of one of Europe’s leading exchange businesses? As Head Controlling Exchanges at SIX/BME, you will be a trusted finance partner to the Head and Management Team of Business Unit Exchanges. You act as business partner and create transparency on financial performance, translate complex data into actionable insights and support sound decision-making across our exchanges in Switzerland and Spain. By combining analytical and financial skills with curiosity and ownership with impact, you will contribute to the continued transformation of financial markets. Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. What You Will Do
• Act as trusted finance business and sparring partner to the Head of Exchanges and his leadership team, supporting and challenging strategic and operational decisions
• Lead key controlling processes, including closing, forecasting, budgeting and mid-term planning, ensuring high-quality insights, transparency and timely delivery
• Prepare, comment and present monthly financial cockpits, variance analyses and ad-hoc deep dives for senior and executive management
• Drive performance steering by identifying risks and opportunities, challenging assumptions and translating financial transparency into actionable insights and clear recommendations
• Continuously improve controlling processes, reporting tools and data foundations, contributing to the continuing success of the Exchanges business What You Bring
• Bachelor and/or Master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting, controlling or a comparable qualification
• At least 4–6 years of experience in financial management or controlling, ideally gained in an international company or through international exposure
• Solid expertise in planning, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis and financial commentary, with a strong ability to turn figures into business-relevant insights
• Strong business partnering skills, with the ability to build trust, challenge constructively and influence senior stakeholders in a dynamic environment
• Good understanding of the financial industry; knowledge of exchange business models or market infrastructure is a strong advantage
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, with the ability to engage effectively with top and executive management; German and Spanish are a plus
• Experience with SAP BI reporting tools such as Analysis for Office and SAP Analytics Cloud is an advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <styl

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Talent Sourcer Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8048 Do you have experience in searching and recruiting best-in-class candidates in the FinTech Industry? Are you customer focused, passionate about candidate experience and skilled at exploring different sources to connect with people? Then our Global Talent Acquisition team wants to hear from you! We are looking for a bright, dedicated team player to join our HR department as Talent Sourcer for the next 6 months to play a vital role in identifying and attracting the best talents for specific open positions across business and corporate units and on various levels. You will be providing hands-on active sourcing services to help drive our growth strategy to the next level. Are you ready to join an agile and diverse team? Then apply now! What You Will Do
• steer the active sourcing strategy to identify and hire the right candidates confident in proactively approaching prospect candidates
• act as a trusted advisor and manage the recruitment process end to end
• manage relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers and other HR specialists
• contribute towards continuous improvement initiatives or Employer Branding projects/events What You Bring
• ideally between 6 months to 1 year of active sourcing experience
• good understanding of end-to-end hiring process, preferably in-house recruiting
• excellent communication skills with knowledge of how to attract and engage candidates, especially passive
• multitasking and well-organized way of working as well as ability to quickly prioritize and handle multiple assignments
• fluency in English. German is a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Guided Tours & BME Events Internship Madrid | Flexible model | Reference 8004 Are you studying and do you have skills in the field of events management, communication and public relations? Are you interested in the Communication and Marketing sector and looking for an interesting internship to learn more about financial sector? If your answer is yes, our Events and Conferences team, responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you. We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a morning internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in the Events and Conferences area. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. What You Will Do
• carry out the guided tours, oversee mailbox and answer inquiries for guided tours, administrating and managing all incoming requests (mail/telephone)
• collaboration in the development of the materials and speeches for the guided tours, acquiring knowledge and history related to the stock market and its surroundings (Stock Exchange Palace)
• support the event managers in all aspects of event management (planning, preparing, execution, event material, invitation and registration management, etc.)
• provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work
• on-Site support at events What You Bring
• studies in Marketing, Communication, Tourism, Bussines Administration or Event Organization
• ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills
• strong organizational skills and personal flexibility
• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills
• very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)
• experience in hosting virtual events is an advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div class="inner " style="font-family:custom277b431a506746d6acae9; font-s

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Backend Java Developer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7838 You want to code? You want to code for one of the most technologically advanced and innovative and stable stock exchanges? Are you ready to work at SIX? We need your engineering skills and passion for designing and implementing new features with great user experience. In your position you will be a part of the Trading Application Development team contributing and driving back-end development of our products. Your main duties as a Software Engineer, working as a Java Developer, will be the following What You Will Do
• exert your excellent Java developing skills with focus on back-end development in the area of primary market trading and trading GUI for the secondary market
• responsible to keep the application compliant to internal and external regulations
• translate user expectations and business requirements into state of the art solution designs following best practice in Java development
• work closely in an interdisciplinary team of developers, testers, product owners and business stakeholders in an agile environment (SCRUM and SAFe) What You Bring
• 5 years of professional hands-on experience in software engineering, with focus on multi-threaded applications development in Java (Java 8+, SpringBoot, WildFly, SOAP and REST services).
• A backpack of experience that includes excellent database knowledge with SQL and Hibernate.
• Excellent knowledge of object-oriented design, event-based message systems, and database design and development and may be also about FIX protocol or financial markets and their infrastructure.
• A positive and result-driven attitude with a high sense for quality, systematic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
• Communicative, team-oriented and resilient personality – German and Spanish is a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. /*Style for JobPage*/ .ic

Fixed Income Sales Manager London | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7858 Do you want to work in a fast moving, client facing market environment? SIX Group is seeking a high performing Sales & Business Development professional to drive revenue growth across our fixed income data products in the UK and European markets. This role is focused on new business acquisition, commercial opportunity creation, and expansion of SIX’s footprint across bond market participants. This is a front office, client facing role for an individual who thrives in fast moving markets, enjoys building pipeline from the ground up, and can translate market structure and trading workflows into clear commercial value. You will work directly with sophisticated clients across trading, execution, and market structure functions, playing a key role in generating sustainable revenue growth. What You Will Do
• originate, develop, and close new revenue opportunities for fixed income data solutions across UK and European markets
• build and manage a strong new business pipeline, targeting institutional bond market participants and prospective new clients
• drive revenue growth through proactive outreach, face to face client meetings, and solution led consultative selling
• translate trading workflows, execution models, and market structure into clear, compelling commercial use cases
• partner with product and commercial teams to align client demand, feedback, and opportunities with product development What You Bring
• proven experience in fixed income data sales or business development with strong knowledge of bond markets and clients
• demonstrated success in new business generation, including pipeline creation and winning new institutional logos
• solid understanding of fixed income execution models and venue dynamics, including RFQ and CLOB market structures
• strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills with confidence engaging traders and senior stakeholders
• fluent English required for daily client engagement and internal collaboration across international teams If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-bal

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. Senior QA Testing Lead Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056 We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. In this role, you will define, implement, and lead testing strategies and quality standards for projects and change requests, helping to deliver high-quality, compliant software in a collaborative and international setting. Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in Spanish is highly preferred. We are looking forward to meet you. Apply now with your CV in English. What You Will Do
• Define and drive a comprehensive test strategy covering functional, non-functional, and regression testing to support successful project delivery and high-quality outcomes.
• Lead QA activities for change requests related to continuous enhancements and maintenance within Clearing applications, ensuring quality standards are met and releases are delivered with confidence throughout the year.
• Establish and oversee an effective defect management process in JIRA, working closely with development and business teams to ensure timely resolution and continuous quality improvement.
• Facilitate regular test management meetings to review progress, resolve concerns, and keep stakeholders aligned on delivery goals and change priorities.
• Identify risks early and proactively escalate critical issues to project management to support informed decisions and timely resolution.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans. What You Bring
• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.
• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.
• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.
• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.
• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.
• Fluency in both verbal and written English. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist HR Service Center (80-100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home Office | Reference 7951

For our dedicated Employee Lifecycle Team, we are looking for an experienced person as a Specialist HR Service Center (m/f) who will provide administrative support for the HR lifecycle from entry to exit for our line managers and employees. As part of our People Vision at SIX, we aim to continuously motivate and inspire our employees. In an exciting environment at the intersection of technology and finance within a dynamic and innovative company, SIX offers you diverse opportunities to fully contribute and develop your potential. We are a collaborative and dynamic team with a strong team spirit, shaping a culture-changing future at SIX together with the business.

The position is temporary until December 2027.

What You Will Do

• First-level support for all line managers and employees on administrative HR topics from entry to exit, as well as general labour law questions, including information on processes, time recording, absences, and fringe benefits

• Independent, accurate, and timely handling of entries, exits, and personnel changes, as well as preparation of contracts, confirmations, and employment references

• Independent updating and maintenance of personnel master data in SuccessFactors

• Responsibility for selected HR specialist topics (e.g. work permits, labour law, digitalisation, fringe benefits)

• Advising employees and line managers on all HR-related matters

What You Bring

• Commercial basic education and a higher professional qualification (e.g. HR specialist certificate)

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar environment

• You are passionate about administrative tasks, can think “outside the box,” enjoy proactively contributing to optimisations, and are happy to take responsibility for their implementation

• Very good user knowledge of MS Office programmes, technical affinity, SAP and/or SuccessFactors is an advantage

• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
